result.finding: No additional system packages installed in the Dockerfile. Application relies entirely on packages pre-included in the eclipse-temurin:8-jre base image.
evidence: No apt-get install, apk add, yum install, or dnf install commands in Dockerfile
Final stage FROM eclipse-temurin:8-jre provides Java 8 JRE (Ubuntu-based image with JRE preinstalled)
Build stage FROM maven:3.9.6-eclipse-temurin-8 installs no additional packages
Application JAR is copied directly: COPY --from=build /app/target/photo-album-*.jar app.jar
Entrypoint uses /bin/sh (provided by the base image)
values: Base image provides: Java 8 JRE (eclipse-temurin), Ubuntu OS utilities, /bin/sh
Package manager: apt (available but not used for additional installs)
